basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old software developer living in Seville, Spain. I have a deep passion for technology, especially building custom PCs, and I'm an avid supporter of Sevilla FC. When I'm not coding or watching football matches, I enjoy refining my style with quality footwear, hence my interest in Thursday Boot. I generally browse Reddit during the evenings after work and on weekends. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time exploring new tech trends and occasional gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have been working as a software developer for over a decade. My expertise lies in backend development, but I've also picked up a lot about PC hardware and optimization through self-teaching and online communities.
